issues.where: storm clouds, valley mist, and peak streamers across all 6 seconds
issues.what: with the camera held still the entire landscape, cloud deck, mist, and trailing wisps remain completely frozen, leaving a dead still picture between faint lightning glows
issues.fix: animate layered cloud drift, pouring valley vapour, and wind-driven spindrift and wisps so the storm stays alive when the camera stops

issues.where: the standing and huddled shaggy animals inside the ice cave
issues.what: all creatures hold completely rigid poses with no weight shift, stepping, head turn, or wind motion in their fur, reading as static models as the camera glides past
issues.fix: add grounded animal motion with weight shifts, subtle breathing, staggered posture changes, and wind-ruffled fur

issues.where: the lightning strike at the peak tip (frames 7665 to 7674)
issues.what: the bolt lingers for seven frames and produces only a soft circular flare with slow sparkler-like particles while failing to flash across the ridge or foreground rock
issues.fix: compress the peak flash into a brief intense strike that lights the entire ridge and rims the foreground rock for an instant before rapid decay

issues.where: cave mouth, snow floor, icicles, and animals during the exterior lightning (frames 8091 to 8095)
issues.what: lightning strikes directly outside the cave opening without casting any bounce light or rim flash into the cave interior, making the storm feel disconnected
issues.fix: drive a sharp blue-white light pulse from the strike across the cave mouth, snow path, icicles, and animal silhouettes

issues.where: the lightning bolt and foreground snowy ridge (frames 7230 to 7238)
issues.what: the same jagged bolt shape hangs on screen for nine frames with only a soft ambient haze in the upper sky and almost no directional light on the foreground ridge
issues.fix: shorten bolt persistence with crisp branching flicker and illuminate the snowy ridge faces and cloud undersides in sync with peak discharge

issues.where: horizontal cloud streamers trailing from the rock face and background lightning (frames 7448 to 7459)
issues.what: the streamers read as flat, rigidly anchored translucent ribbons rather than blowing vapour, and the thin lightning lines light neither the rock face nor the clouds
issues.fix: replace the ribbon-like strips with turbulent wind-sheared mist and add responsive flash lighting on the nearby rock and cloud deck

issues.where: the lightning bolt and impact glow after the cut (frames 7015 to 7024)
issues.what: the bolt remains frozen in one shape for six frames and the impact spot lingers brightly through frame 7024 without lighting the foreground peak
issues.fix: give the discharge a sharper onset and decay and cast transient flash illumination across the snow-covered peak
